about_the_game:
A single-player deck builder game where you control a yokai to defeat other yokai. Conquer dungeons using special moves powered by yokai energy, built upon the systems of roguelike and card games.

Feature Introduction

Control a Yokai: As the player progresses through the scenarios, it is possible to ally with yokai, ninjas, gods, etc.



The allied yokai can be sent into dungeons and engage in battles. Each yokai has its own characteristics and special moves, which greatly change the style of combat.



In the dungeon, you can buy items at the shop or sell cards.
Deck Building and Dungeons: Players can build decks by conquering dungeons. In addition to cards, items, money, and equipment appear upon victory. Aim to defeat the dungeon bosses with a powerful deck.

Standby Phase: As the scenario progresses, a blacksmith or dojo will be unlocked. At the dojo or blacksmith, you can buy equipment, items, and cards that can be owned at the start of a dungeon challenge.

Challenge Mode

After clearing the scenario, challenge mode will be unlocked. In challenge mode, you can take on the strongest dungeon configuration. Also, in challenge mode, treasure chest gacha will be unlocked, where you can get items to take into the dungeon. Furthermore, you can unlock adult costumes in the gacha screen, and purchase a system where you can strip yokai's costumes during battles.




Sexual Content, Violence

This game contains anime-style blood splatter expressions, drinking, nipple depictions, and depictions of edited female genitalia.


Implemented Contents

Over 300 cards
Over 200 pieces of equipment
Over 20 controllable yokai
Over 50 enemy yokai
Over 20 special events

Adult Content

Over 60 standing-picture contents (difference in standing pictures for each yokai)
Adult events for each yokai
Adult events upon defeat
